question: **Mangoes are high in calories. What is its main source of calories?**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Carbohydrates**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The last two sentences of the second paragraph states that, *"...*____*it provides roughly 80 kilocalories per 100 g (a medium-sized ripe mango would carry about 130-150 calories), **which mainly come from carbohydrates **(20 per cent)."*__
 
• From here it is clear that its main source of calories is Carbohydrates.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
